title: CET Haryana 2026 Notification Released - Apply Now
excerpt: Haryana Staff Selection Commission has released the CET notification for 2026. Check eligibility, important dates, and application process.
content:
The Haryana Staff Selection Commission (HSSC) has officially released the Common Eligibility Test (CET) notification for 2026. This is a significant opportunity for candidates seeking Group C and Group D positions in Haryana government departments.

**Key Highlights:**
- Total Vacancies: 15,000+
- Application Start Date: January 20, 2026
- Last Date to Apply: February 28, 2026
- Exam Date: April 2026 (Tentative)

**Eligibility Criteria:**
- Age: 18-42 years (relaxation as per rules)
- Educational Qualification: 10+2 for Group D, Graduation for Group C
- Must be a resident of Haryana

**How to Apply:**
1. Visit the official HSSC website
2. Register with your details
3. Fill the application form
4. Upload required documents
5. Pay the application fee
6. Submit and take a printout

Stay tuned for more updates and start your preparation with our comprehensive CET study material.

title: SSC CGL 2026 Tier-1 Admit Card Released
excerpt: Staff Selection Commission has released the admit cards for CGL 2026 Tier-1 examination. Download now and check exam schedule.
content:
The Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has released the admit cards for the Combined Graduate Level (CGL) Examination 2026 Tier-1.

**Important Information:**
- Exam Dates: February 1-15, 2026
- Exam Mode: Computer Based Test (CBT)
- Duration: 60 minutes
- Total Questions: 100
- Maximum Marks: 200

**How to Download Admit Card:**
1. Visit SSC official website ssc.nic.in
2. Click on 'Admit Card' tab
3. Select your region
4. Enter Registration Number and Date of Birth
5. Download and print your admit card

**Important Instructions:**
- Carry original ID proof along with admit card
- Reach the exam center 30 minutes before reporting time
- Electronic devices are strictly prohibited
- Follow the dress code guidelines

Good luck with your preparation!

title: Haryana Police Constable Result 2025 Declared
excerpt: HSSC has declared the final result for Haryana Police Constable Recruitment 2025. Check the merit list and next steps.
content:
The Haryana Staff Selection Commission has declared the final result for the Police Constable Recruitment 2025.

**Result Summary:**
- Total Posts: 7,000
- Candidates Selected: 7,000 + Waitlist
- Cut-off Marks: General - 72%, OBC - 65%, SC - 55%

**How to Check Result:**
1. Visit HSSC official website
2. Click on 'Results' section
3. Find Haryana Police Constable 2025
4. Enter your Roll Number
5. View and download your result

**Next Steps for Selected Candidates:**
- Document Verification: January 2026
- Physical Measurement Test: February 2026

Congratulations to all selected candidates!

title: HTET 2026 Application Process Started - Complete Guide
excerpt: Haryana Teacher Eligibility Test 2026 applications are now open. Complete guide on eligibility, syllabus, and preparation strategy.
content:
The Board of School Education Haryana (BSEH) has started the application process for HTET 2026.

**Important Dates:**
- Application Start: January 5, 2026
- Last Date: February 10, 2026
- Exam Date: March 2026
- Result Date: April 2026

**Levels of HTET:**
1. Level 1 - Primary Teacher (Class 1-5)
2. Level 2 - TGT Teacher (Class 6-8)
3. Level 3 - PGT Teacher (Class 9-12)

**Eligibility:**
- Level 1: 12th + D.El.Ed/B.El.Ed
- Level 2: Graduation + B.Ed
- Level 3: Post Graduation + B.Ed

Start your preparation early and stay consistent!
